messages:
rebecca: Heads upI merged the index PR but noticed the Talon-XS model card still lists \"supported_backends: [cuda, rocm]\". Runtime only validates \"cuda\" for the 8-bit kernels right now. We should clarify and add a compatibility note. @tom @mike

 tom: Good catch. I think the card got carried over from the upstream model page. I'll prepare a tiny PR to change supported_backends to just \"cuda\" and add a note: \"ROCm support planned; currently not validated for q8_0 kernels\".

 mike: While we're touching that card, can we also update the limits section? The card shows context_window: 2048 but infra runs show stable up to 3072 on Talon-XS-12GB with q8_0. Not sure if we want to advertise that as official.

 nina: Recommend listing the conservative documented limit (2048) and then adding an \"observed max\" row in Performance: Observed max context: 3072 (12GB, q8_0) with a short caveat about memory/latency tradeoffs. That keeps expectations safe.

 rebecca: Agreed. Use two rows: \"Documented context_window\" and \"Observed max (lab)\" with date+hw. That avoids support promises.

 evan: Also saw the Python quickstart still uses the old streaming API shape. New SDK now returns an iterator over chunks via .stream(). Example to paste: ```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
for chunk in c.generate(model=\"talon-xs\", input=\"Explain...\", max_new_tokens=128).stream():
    print(chunk.text, end=\"\")
```

 mike: Nice. I'll update both Python and TS snippets. Also add a tiny migration blurb: \"stream() yields chunks; previous .chunks field removed\".

 tom: There's a broken anchor in docs/model-catalog/index.md linking to model-card:talon-xs/perf. I'll fix that in the same PR. It's causing CI link check to fail.

 doc-bot: checklist: 1) change supported_backends; 2) add observed max context row with hardware+quant profile+date; 3) replace quickstart streaming snippet and add migration note; 4) fix index anchor; 5) include bench command used; 6) add GH assignees and labels.

 nina: For the bench row I'll add: \"Observed: ~95 tok/s @ seq=512 batch=4, observed max context 3072 (12GB, q8_0)\" and include command `./bench.py --model talon-xs --batch 4 --seq 512 --quant q8_0`. Date: 2024-07-02.

 rebecca: Plan: tom opens PR with card edits + index anchor fix. mike updates snippets + migration note in same PR if small; otherwise separate with cross-ref. nina will add bench numbers and bench command. I'll review and merge once link-check passes.

 mike: Assigning GH: @tom card+linkfix, @mike snippets, @nina bench. Labels: docs/bug docs/migration. I'll avoid force-merging until bench row is present.

 evan: One more thing: add a short compatibility note that Talon-XS requires kernel >= 2.1.0 for the new KV cache API. Runtime confirmed.

 rebecca: OK, add that line under Compatibility with a link to release notes for kernel 2.1.0. Thanks all.

 doc-bot: reminder: keep message short in card, add \"Observed\" row, and include exact bench command for reproducibility.
